ValidationRule.description: Dispatch audit: geo distance, ISO-week cutoffs, handling, tracking shape, weight math and transit duration formatting all in one pass.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'In Transit'), OR( ISBLANK(Shipped_At__c), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Shipped_At__c)), ISOWEEK(DATEVALUE(Shipped_At__c)) = 53, NOT(INCLUDES(Handling__c, 'Signature Required'))), AND(NULLVALUE(Transit_Seconds__c, 0) > 0, LEN(FORMATDURATION(Transit_Seconds__c)) = 0), ROUND(NULLVALUE(Weight_Kg__c, 0), 0) > 20000, AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Origin__latitude__s)), NOT(ISBLANK(Destination__latitude__s)), DISTANCE(Origin__c, Destination__c, 'km') < 0.1), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Tracking_Number__c)), MOD(LEN(Tracking_Number__c), 2) = 1, NOT(ISPICKVAL(Carrier__c, 'USPS')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Carrier__c, 'UPS'))) ) )
